```{r}

# 1. Install required packages

install.packages("DESeq2")

library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(ggrepel)
library(ggplot2)
library(here)
library(DESeq2)

```

```{r}
#Assign cell type identities to clusters
crc <- readRDS(here("data/crc.rds"))
new_cluster_ids <- c("Plasma cells", "CD4+ T cells", "NK/Gamma-delta T cells", 
                     "Naive B cells", "NK/CD8+ cells", "Epithelial cells", "T cells", 
                     "B cells", "Macrophages", "Regulatory T cells", "Neutrophils",
                     "INHBA_SULF1_CAF", "Macrophages", "Epithelial cells", "SPON1_CAF", 
                     "Mast cells", "INHBA_SULF1_CAF", "Germinal-centre B cells", 
                     "Epithelial cells", "Endothelial cells", "Cycling cells", 
                     "Epithelial cells", "Epithelial cells", "Plasma cells", "DPT_CAF", 
                     "B cells", "Activated T cells", "Plasma cells", 
                     "Schwann/glial cells","Dendritic cells", "B cells")
names(new_cluster_ids) <- levels(crc)
crc <- RenameIdents(crc, new_cluster_ids)
annotated_umap <- DimPlot(crc, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE, pt.size = 0.5) + NoLegend()
annotated_umap
```

```{r}
##Pseudobulking for DGEA
crc$cell_type <- Idents(crc)
pseudobulk_crc <- AggregateExpression(crc, assays = "RNA", return.seurat = T, group.by = c("sample_id", "condition", "cell_type"))
head(pseudobulk_crc@meta.data)
```

```{r}
#Create a new metadata column
pseudobulk_crc$cell.type_condition <- paste(pseudobulk_crc$cell_type, pseudobulk_crc$condition, sep = "_")

#Rename the cell identities
Idents(pseudobulk_crc) <- "cell.type_condition"
bulk_crc_de <- FindMarkers(object = pseudobulk_crc, 
                           ident.1 = "Tumor", 
                           ident.2 = "Normal", 
                           test.use = "DESeq2")
```

```{r}
schwann_de <- FindMarkers(object = pseudobulk_crc, 
                          ident.1 = "Schwann/glial cells_Tumor", 
                          ident.2 = "Schwann/glial cells_Normal", 
                          test.use = "DESeq2")
head(schwann_de, n = 10)
```

```{r}
#Create a new column for differential expression based on statistical significance and log2FC
schwann_de <- schwann_de %>%
    mutate(
      differential = case_when(
        avg_log2FC > 1 & p_val_adj < 0.05  ~ "Upregulated",
        avg_log2FC < -1 & p_val_adj < 0.05 ~ "Downregulated",
        TRUE                               ~ "Not significant"
      ),

      # Prevent infinite values when adjusted p-value equals zero
      minus_log10_padj = -log10(
        pmax(p_val_adj, .Machine$double.xmin)
      )
    )

  table(schwann_de$differential)
```

### Heatmap for Schwann/glial cells (Tumor vs Normal)

```{r}
# Select top 10 upregulated genes
top_up_schwann <- schwann_de %>% 
  filter(differential == "Upregulated") %>% 
  dplyr::arrange(desc(avg_log2FC), p_val_adj) %>%
  dplyr::slice(1:10)

# Select top 10 downregulated genes
top_down_schwann <- schwann_de %>% 
  filter(differential == "Downregulated") %>% 
  dplyr::arrange(avg_log2FC, p_val_adj) %>% 
  dplyr::slice(1:10)

# Combine UP and DOWN genes into a single dataframe
top_genes_schwann <- bind_rows(top_up_schwann, top_down_schwann)

# Extract gene names vector (adjust column name if 'Gene' instead of 'X')
genes_to_plot <- if ("Gene" %in% colnames(top_genes_schwann)) {
  top_genes_schwann$Gene
} else {
  top_genes_schwann$X
}


# Subset Seurat object directly for Schwann cells (Tumor vs Normal)
schwann_pb_m2 <- subset(
  pseudobulk_crc, 
  idents = c("Schwann/glial cells_Tumor", "Schwann/glial cells_Normal")
)


heatmap_schwann_m2 <- DoHeatmap(
    object = schwann_pb_m2,
    features = genes_to_plot,
    group.by = "condition",
    assay = "RNA",
    slot = "scale.data",
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colors = c("#2166AC", "white", "#B2182B")
  ) +
  ggtitle("Top DEGs in Schwann/glial cells (Method 2: Primary log2FC Rank)") +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(
      size = 9,
      face = "italic"
    )
  )

# Display the output
heatmap_schwann_m2
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(dplyr)

# 1. Select the top 10 UP and top 10 DOWN genes (your exact code)
top_up <- schwann_de %>%
  filter(
    differential == "Upregulated",
    !is.na(p_val_adj)
  ) %>%
  arrange(p_val_adj, desc(avg_log2FC)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10)

top_down <- schwann_de %>%
  filter(
    differential == "Downregulated",
    !is.na(p_val_adj)
  ) %>%
  arrange(p_val_adj, avg_log2FC) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10)

# Combine into a single vector of 20 top genes
top_20_genes <- unique(c(top_up$Gene, top_down$Gene))
```

# 2. Build the Volcano Plot with all genes, labeling ONLY top_20_genes
```{r}
volcano_schwann <- ggplot(
    schwann_de,
    aes(
      x = avg_log2FC,
      y = -log10(p_val_adj),
      color = differential
    )
  ) +
    geom_point(
      size = 1.2,
      alpha = 0.7
    ) +
    geom_vline(
      xintercept = c(-1, 1),
      linetype = "dashed",
      color = "grey40"
    ) +
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = -log10(0.05),
      linetype = "dashed",
      color = "grey40"
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c(
        "Upregulated" = "#D73027",
        "Downregulated" = "#2878B5",
        "Not significant" = "grey75"
      )
    ) +
    # Pass ONLY the top 20 genes subset to geom_text_repel
    geom_text_repel(
      data = subset(schwann_de, Gene %in% top_20_genes),
      aes(label = Gene),
      size = 3.5,
      max.overlaps = 20,
      fontface = "italic"
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    labs(
      title = "Schwann/glial cells: Tumor vs Normal",
      x = expression("Average log"[2]*" Fold Change"),
      y = expression("-log"[10]*"(adjusted p-value)"),
      color = NULL
    )

volcano_schwann
```
